import copy
import numpy as np
query = np.array([[0.0, 0.0]])
normalized_distances = np.array(
    [10.0, 10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 12.0, 40.0, 55.0]
)
library = np.zeros((7, 1, 2), dtype=float)
library[:, 0, 0] = 0.01 * normalized_distances
counts = np.ones(7, dtype=int)
pair_records = np.array(
    [
        [4, 0, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [1, 4, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [4, 2, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [3, 4, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [1, 5, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
    ],
    dtype=float,
)
query_hybrid = np.array(
    [0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.95, 0.10, 0.10]
)
q = query
l = library
c = counts
p = pair_records
t = query_hybrid.copy()
m = query_hybrid.copy()
assert np.allclose(hsqc_retrieval_gain(copy.deepcopy(q), copy.deepcopy(l), copy.deepcopy(c), copy.deepcopy(p), copy.deepcopy(t), copy.deepcopy(m), top_k=copy.deepcopy(1)), target)

import copy
import numpy as np
query = np.array([[0.0, 0.0]])
normalized_distances = np.array(
    [10.0, 10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 12.0, 40.0, 55.0]
)
library = np.zeros((7, 1, 2), dtype=float)
library[:, 0, 0] = 0.01 * normalized_distances
counts = np.ones(7, dtype=int)
pair_records = np.array(
    [
        [4, 0, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [1, 4, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [4, 2, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [3, 4, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
        [1, 5, 20.0, 0.95, 0.95],
    ],
    dtype=float,
)
query_hybrid = np.array(
    [0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.95, 0.10, 0.10]
)
q = query
l = library
c = counts
p = pair_records
t = query_hybrid.copy()
m = query_hybrid.copy()

order=np.array([1,5,4,0,6,2,3])
inverse=np.empty_like(order)
inverse[order]=np.arange(len(order))
l=l[order]
c=c[order]
t=t[order]
m=m[order]
p=p.copy()
p[:,:2]=inverse[p[:,:2].astype(int)]
assert np.allclose(hsqc_retrieval_gain(copy.deepcopy(q), copy.deepcopy(l), copy.deepcopy(c), copy.deepcopy(p), copy.deepcopy(t), copy.deepcopy(m), top_k=copy.deepcopy(1)), target)
